title: Represented homotopy classes and termwise sections
statement:
Let $h:Y\to S$ be any morphism of schemes, $U\to S$ an etale object, $W=U\times_S Y$, $A=h^*\mathbb Z[U]$, and $I$ any cochain complex of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$. Here $\mathbb Z[U]$, its identity generator $g\in\Gamma(W,A|_W)$, and restriction are those of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. There is an additive group isomorphism
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{K(Y_{\mathrm{et}})}(A[0],I)\cong H^0(\Gamma(W,I|_W))$$
which sends the homotopy class of a chain map $f$ to the image of the generator's single-complex class under $H^0(\Gamma(W,f|_W))$. This latter map is exactly `chainEvaluation h U I f`. No boundedness or injectivity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03Q8; Cohomology on Sites Tags 072W (injective section complexes), 0BKV and 0D6F (restricted K-injective computation)

proof.text: The inverse-image/direct-image adjunction, sheafification adjunction, free-abelian adjunction and Yoneda identify Hom(A,G) with sections over W for every abelian sheaf G. The unit formula and identity formula show this equivalence sends f to its evaluation on the pulled-back represented identity. Naturality makes these additive equivalences commute with the differentials of I.

Apply the from-single cochain equivalence in each degree to obtain an isomorphism HomComplex(A[0],I) with the termwise sections complex. Zeroth Hom-complex cohomology is homotopy classes (Mathlib CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv and leftHomologyData); take zeroth homology of the chain isomorphism. On a chain map, the single-complex homology isomorphism gives exactly chainEvaluation, including zero complexes and empty W.

theorem exists_rawRestrictedHomotopySectionsIso {S Y : Scheme.{v}}
    (h : Y ⟶ S) (U : S.Etale)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) :
    ∃ e : AddCommGrpCat.of
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h).obj (freeSheaf S U))) ⟶
          (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≅
        (((underivedSections
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj U)).mapHomologicalComplex
           (.up ℤ)).obj I).homology 0,
      ∀ f, e.hom ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).map f) =
        chainEvaluation h U I f
